name: paper-scout
description: A field notebook for academic literature research: token-lean paper search and reading across your Zotero library (read-only), Semantic Scholar, arXiv and OpenAlex.
long_description: Compact one-line search results, TLDR-first paper details, citation snowballing, recommendations, author lookup, and section-level reading of open full text (arXiv HTML, open-access PDFs, or local PDFs). Everything is cached on disk so repeated lookups cost nothing. Keeps a research map in your project folder (concepts, versioned conceptual frameworks, a working ontology, the versioned idea, tasks) and serves the Research Desk, a local page on your Mac (127.0.0.1) to work with it.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find papers across Zotero, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex and arXiv with deduplication and project memory

tools.name: paper
tools.description: TLDR, abstract, metadata, BibTeX or Zotero notes for up to 50 papers

tools.name: graph
tools.description: Citations, references, recommendations and author corpora

tools.name: read
tools.description: Section map, sections, matching passages, figures or pages of a paper

tools.name: code
tools.description: List code repositories for papers without exploring them

tools.name: session
tools.description: Project memory: screening marks, evidence cards, search log, roles, BibTeX export

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Mechanical citation check of a draft on disk

tools.name: map
tools.description: Research map of the project: concepts with definitions, the conceptual framework and ontology, questions, tasks, claims with evidence, and the versioned idea, kept in the project folder.

tools.name: desk
tools.description: Link to the Research Desk, a local page for screening, cards, searches and BibTeX export

s2_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API key (optional)
s2_api_key.description: Free key from semanticscholar.org/product/api. Without it, searches share a rate-limited pool and may fall back to OpenAlex.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key (optional)
openalex_api_key.description: Only needed if OpenAlex asks for one.

mailto.title: Contact email (recommended)
mailto.description: Enables Unpaywall (free legal copies of journal articles) and the faster polite pools of OpenAlex and Crossref. Only sent to those services.

zotero_dir.title: Zotero data folder
zotero_dir.description: The folder containing zotero.sqlite (Zotero Settings, Advanced, Files and Folders). Leave empty for ~/Zotero.

library_proxy.title: Library proxy prefix
library_proxy.description: Prefix for off-campus library links shown when no open copy exists (University of Groningen by default).
